prompt_md: On a 5 by 5 grid of dots, how many squares have all four corners on dots? Tilted squares count too.
prompt_short: Squares with corners on a 5 by 5 dot grid, tilted ones included?
hint_md: A tilted square fits snugly inside a bigger upright one.
explain_intuition_md: The 30 upright squares are the easy part. Every upright square of side k also has k - 1 tilted squares inscribed in it, with corners on its edges. Adding those brings the total to 50.
